reviews.title: Predatory Developer. Google it.
reviews.text:
In the name of money this developer hides everything behind a pay wall. They even acquire beloved companies and then slap paywalls which were previously not there.
This app is the same.
Greed has plagued his and the his team’s mind. All good though, this wealth is temporary. We know our souls go on afterwards, and I think we know where he will go after — hence why there’s “no” information available about the lead dev. ;)
Come to Texas.
